privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: CLB Private Club is a student project made as part of the 42 school curriculum. This page explains what data we collect, why, and what you can do about it.

identity.label: Username and email address
identity.text: they identify your account and let you log in.

password.label: Password
password.text: never stored in plain text. We only keep a salted hash (argon2id) that cannot be turned back into the password.

id42.label: 42 identifier
id42.text: if you log in with 42, we get your identifier, your login and your email from the 42 intranet API. We never receive your 42 password.

badge.label: NFC badge
badge.text: if you link a badge, we store a hash of its identifier (HMAC-SHA-256 with a secret key of the server), never the identifier itself.

friends.label: Friends and messages
friends.text: friend requests and the messages you exchange with your friends.

apiKeys.label: API keys
apiKeys.text: if you create some, we only keep their hash.

sessions.label: Sessions
sessions.text: the login and expiry date of each open session.

privacy.why: This data is only used to run your account: log you in (password, 42 account or NFC badge), show your profile, your friends and your messages. It is never sold, shared or used for advertising.
privacy.cookieSid: keeps your session open for 7 days at most. It is deleted when you log out.
privacy.cookieOauth: only present during a login with 42, for 10 minutes at most. It protects this login against request forgery attacks.
privacy.cookiesNote: These cookies are strictly necessary for the site to work, out of reach of JavaScript ({httpOnly}) and only sent over HTTPS ({secure}). No tracking or advertising cookies.

security.https: All communication with the server goes over HTTPS.
security.bruteForce: Login attempts that come too close together are blocked to limit brute-force attacks.
security.badge: An NFC badge can be copied: it is a login shortcut, not an absolute proof of identity.

privacy.thirdParty: 42 intranet (api.intra.42.fr), only if you choose to log in with 42. The site loads no resource from any other service.
privacy.retention: Your data is kept as long as your account exists. Deleting your account also deletes your sessions, your badge, your friends and your messages. You can unlink your badge at any time from the Settings page, which deletes its hash.
privacy.rights: Under the GDPR, you can ask to access, correct or delete your data by contacting the project team.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using CLB Private Club, you accept the terms below. If you do not agree, do not use the site.
terms.service: CLB Private Club is a student project of the 42 school. No real money is involved: there are no deposits, no bets and no real winnings. The scores and rewards shown are fictional.

account.required: You must provide a username, a valid email address and a password of at least 8 characters.
account.secret: You are responsible for keeping your password and your NFC badge private.
account.lostBadge: If you lose your badge, unlink it from the Settings page.
account.personal: An account is personal: do not use someone else's.

use.accounts: No attempts to access other players' accounts.
use.attacks: No attacks on the service (brute force, overload, exploiting vulnerabilities).
use.messages: No insulting, hateful or illegal messages sent to other players.
use.automation: No automated use of the site without an API key.

terms.suspend: We may suspend an account that does not follow these rules.
terms.availability: The service is provided as is, for educational purposes. It may be interrupted, changed or removed at any time, with no guarantee of availability.
terms.responsible: Even without real money, gambling can become a problem. If you or someone close to you is affected, you can contact Joueurs Info Service (France) at 09 74 75 13 13 (standard rate call) or on joueurs-info-service.fr.
terms.data: How your data is handled is described in our {link}.
